sentences.en: We had a fan question from Brittany Y, Sarah M, and many more.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了来自布列塔尼·Y、莎拉·M以及许多其他人的粉丝提问。

sentences.en: Who is the baby that played Astrid?
sentences.zh: 饰演阿斯特丽德的那个婴儿是谁？

sentences.en: I will tell you, thanks to Jamesopedia.
sentences.zh: 多亏了《詹姆斯百科》，我来告诉你们。

sentences.en: First of all, you know, babies are played by many babies.
sentences.zh: 首先，你们知道，婴儿角色通常由多个婴儿轮流扮演。

sentences.en: Sometimes they're a set of twins.
sentences.zh: 有时是一对双胞胎。

sentences.en: Like in the case of Cece, Cece was this set of twins, and it was the same twin girls all through the show.
sentences.zh: 就像西西的情况，西西是由一对双胞胎扮演的，而且整个剧集里都是那对双胞胎女孩。

sentences.en: They were absolute sweethearts, and I loved them.
sentences.zh: 她们绝对是小甜心，我超爱她们。

sentences.en: But sometimes, especially with a baby this little, it's like three babies, five babies, lots of babies.
sentences.zh: 但有时，特别是对于这么小的婴儿，可能需要三个、五个，甚至更多的婴儿来演。

sentences.en: Oh, Philip was several different babies, and then a different toddler.
sentences.zh: 噢，菲利普就是由好几个不同的婴儿扮演的，后来又换成了不同的幼儿演员。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So this is because there are rules about babies working on a set.
sentences.zh: 这是因为关于婴儿在片场工作是有相关规定的。

sentences.en: They can only work for like 20 minutes.
sentences.zh: 他们每次只能工作大概20分钟。

sentences.en: And I think that's a good thing.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这挺好的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Also, if you have a baby and one of them's fussy, you can swap them out for a different baby.
sentences.zh: 而且，如果你有婴儿，其中一个闹脾气了，你可以换另一个婴儿上来。

sentences.en: They're all dressed the same.
sentences.zh: 他们穿的衣服都一模一样。

sentences.en: You go backstage, and there's like six babies in the same outfit.
sentences.zh: 你去后台，会有六个穿着同样衣服的婴儿。

sentences.en: So Astrid was played first by a set of twins and another baby.
sentences.zh: 所以阿斯特丽德最初是由一对双胞胎和另一个婴儿轮流扮演的。

sentences.en: Here's the crazy thing.
sentences.zh: 最疯狂的是这个。

sentences.en: The twins' names were Matthew and Joey Levinson.
sentences.zh: 那对双胞胎的名字叫马修·莱文森和乔伊·莱文森。

sentences.en: Crazy.
sentences.zh: 太疯狂了。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: And they were playing Jan Levinson's baby.
sentences.zh: 而他们扮演的正是简·莱文森的孩子。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The other baby was Harvey Green.
sentences.zh: 另一个婴儿叫哈维·格林。

sentences.en: So her babies were the Levinson Green babies.
sentences.zh: 所以她的孩子就是莱文森-格林宝宝。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 行吧。

sentences.en: And then that was on one day.
sentences.zh: 那是一天的情况。

sentences.en: The other day, we had a set of triplets playing Astrid.
sentences.zh: 另一天，我们有一组三胞胎来扮演阿斯特丽德。

sentences.en: They were Chase, Chloe, and Juliet Purcell.
sentences.zh: 他们是蔡斯、克洛伊和朱丽叶·珀塞尔。

sentences.en: So those are all the babies.
sentences.zh: 所以这些就是所有的婴儿了。

sentences.en: We also had a fake baby.
sentences.zh: 我们还有一个假婴儿。

sentences.en: We did have a fake baby.
sentences.zh: 我们确实有个假婴儿。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it's really funny because if you look at the call sheet scene by scene,
sentences.zh: 这真的很有趣，因为如果你逐场查看通告单，

sentences.en: it'll say real baby or fake baby, like what we're using in the scene.
sentences.zh: 上面会写着真婴儿还是假婴儿，标明我们在那场戏里用的是哪一个。

sentences.en: And they would stagger them, right?
sentences.zh: 他们会把这些安排错开，对吧？

sentences.en: Because the babies could only work for 20 minutes.
sentences.zh: 因为婴儿每次只能工作20分钟。

sentences.en: So you'd have a scene with a real baby and then a scene with a fake baby.
sentences.zh: 所以你会拍一场用真婴儿的戏，然后接一场用假婴儿的戏。

sentences.en: Well, Michael walks out of the kitchen, and he sees Jan with the baby.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔从厨房走出来，看到简抱着孩子。

sentences.en: I can't imagine how he felt.
sentences.zh: 我无法想象他当时是什么心情。

sentences.en: He'd been to all of his birthing classes with her.
sentences.zh: 他明明和她一起上过所有的产前辅导课。

sentences.en: And then he was sort of left out of this big moment.
sentences.zh: 结果他却被排除在这个重要时刻之外。

sentences.en: And he confronts Jan about it.
sentences.zh: 于是他去找简对质。

sentences.en: This is one of my favorite couplets of dialogue from the whole episode.
sentences.zh: 这是整集中我最喜欢的对白之一。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: It's so rich.
sentences.zh: 内容太丰富了。

sentences.zh: 迈克尔问，你为什么不叫我？

sentences.en: I could have helped.
sentences.zh: 我本可以帮忙的。

sentences.en: Jan said, well, the birth instructor thought it wasn't a good idea for you to be there.
sentences.zh: 简说，产前辅导老师觉得你不适合在场。

sentences.en: So Michael says, oh, man, him, that guy, he had no sense of humor.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔就说，天哪，那家伙，他一点幽默感都没有。

sentences.en: And I proved him wrong in so many ways.
sentences.zh: 我用各种方式证明了他错了。

sentences.en: And it just made me think about these classes.
sentences.zh: 这让我不禁想到了这些课程。

sentences.en: I wish we could have seen Michael trying to do comedy bits with, like, a birthing instructor.
sentences.zh: 真希望我们能看到迈克尔试图在产前辅导老师面前讲段子的样子。

sentences.en: I would have loved to have seen that scene.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想看那场戏。

sentences.en: I think what Jan has done to Michael is so cruel.
sentences.zh: 我觉得简对迈克尔做的事太残忍了。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: That she didn't call him.
sentences.zh: 她竟然没叫他。

sentences.en: And also in that scene, Jan is like, Michael, you don't know what I have been through.
sentences.zh: 而且在那场戏里，简还说，迈克尔，你根本不知道我经历了什么。

sentences.en: And he said, no.
sentences.zh: 他说，不。

sentences.en: No, I don't.
sentences.zh: 不，我没有。

sentences.en: And I love Steve's delivery on that.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢史蒂夫在那里的演绎方式。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: I guess she feels bad and she lets him hold the baby, but it says the baby has to stay in the car seat.
sentences.zh: 我想她觉得过意不去，就让他抱了孩子，但她说孩子必须待在安全座椅里。

sentences.en: And then Michael has this very sweet talking head where he says he loves babies and he tries to pick them up and hold one every day.
sentences.zh: 然后迈克尔有一段非常温馨的采访，他说他很喜欢婴儿，每天都试着去抱抱他们。

sentences.en: It just nourishes him.
sentences.zh: 这让他感到满足。

sentences.en: And then we see this really sweet montage of Michael and babies.
sentences.zh: 接着我们看到了一段迈克尔和婴儿们在一起的温馨剪辑。

sentences.en: And the babies love him.
sentences.zh: 而且婴儿们都很喜欢他。

sentences.en: They really do.
sentences.zh: 他们确实很喜欢。

sentences.en: Well, that's because it's Steve Carell is holding the baby.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那是因为抱着孩子的是史蒂夫·卡瑞尔。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: I mean, not to say that they wouldn't have loved Michael, but Steve is a natural with kids.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，并不是说他们不会喜欢迈克尔，但史蒂夫确实很有孩子缘。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: and Stacey M.
sentences.zh: 和斯泰西·M.的粉丝提问。

sentences.zh: 旁边那位也是迪恩的妻子，塔莎。

sentences.en: At nine minutes, 15 seconds, we have double baby.

sentences.zh: 她告诉所有人她是《办公室》里的婴儿之一。

sentences.en: Isabel just had her 13th birthday.
sentences.zh: 伊莎贝尔刚过了13岁生日。

sentences.en: There was this baby boom.
sentences.zh: 当时确实有一场婴儿潮。

sentences.zh: 能让我们的孩子出现在片场对我们来说真的很有趣。

sentences.zh: 我经常被问到她是否出现在这一集里。

sentences.zh: 她没有。

sentences.en: And you know why?
sentences.zh: 你知道为什么吗？

sentences.en: Oh.
